situation: Coworker from marketing sent a 1-hour 'brainstorm' invite for tomorrow with no agenda. I'm on the data team and figure they want numbers from me. I'm slammed this week.
reply: Hi Rosa, I'll skip the brainstorm tomorrow. If what you need from me is the signup numbers by channel for Q3, I can drop them in your doc by noon so they're there for the session. Does that cover it?
note: Name what they likely need, decline the format, and give it another way with a time. No 'I'm swamped'.

situation: 我是小团队的技术负责人，每周一上午有个一小时的全员周会，大部分内容跟我无关，我想退出，但老板是发起人。
reply: 王总，想跟您商量一下：从下周开始我想不参加周一上午的全员周会了。技术这块的进展我每周五下班前会更新到共享周报里，您周一开会前就能看到。如果有议题需要我，提前说一声我就进来讲那一段。您看可以吗？
note: 对上级退出例会：说清由什么替代你原来的贡献，留一个随叫随到的口子，最后请对方确认。

situation: Some SaaS sales rep has emailed me 4 times this month asking for '15 minutes' to show me their HR tool. I'm the ops manager at a 40-person company. Want him to stop.
reply: Hi Kyle, thanks for following up. We're not looking at HR tools this year, so please take me off the follow-up list. If that changes, I'll get in touch.
note: A clear 'not now' ends the chase faster than silence. No reason to argue with.

situation: I declined my director's one-hour 'sync' on the migration plan and offered a written update instead. She replied 'I'd really prefer to talk it through live.'
reply: Sure, let's do it. Could you add the one or two decisions you need from me to the invite so I come prepared? And could we keep it to 30 minutes? I'll bring the cutover timeline and the rollback plan.
note: When a senior person insists, go, but shape it: ask for the decision and cap the time. Raise the format again later with evidence.

situation: A founder I don't know, Arjun, messaged me on LinkedIn asking for a 30-minute call to 'pick my brain' about raising a Series A. I get a few of these every week and can't do them all.
reply: Hi Arjun, thanks for reaching out, and good luck with the raise. I'm not taking calls like this at the moment, but I'm happy to help by email: send me your two most pressing questions about the Series A and I'll reply by Friday.
note: Strangers asking for time: decline the call, cap the help at two questions, and give a date you can keep.

situation: I'm a freelance designer. My client Daniel just emailed at 2pm asking to 'jump on a quick call at 5 today' about the brochure, no agenda. I'm booked all afternoon on another client's work, and the brochure proofs are due to him Thursday anyway.
reply: Hi Daniel, I can't do 5 today. If it's about the brochure, send me the questions or changes you have in mind and I'll reply in writing by 10am tomorrow, Wednesday. The full proofs are still on track for Thursday. If one thing truly can't wait until tomorrow, tell me what it is and I'll answer it tonight. Does that work?
note: A client's same-day 'quick call' is usually habit: ask for the question, answer it in writing, and keep one narrow path open in case it really is urgent.

situation: 我是项目的产品负责人。市场部的小赵约了明天周三下午两点一小时的“上线沟通会”，拉了八个人。其实现在只剩上线日期一个问题没定。
reply: 小赵，明天的会能不能改成20分钟？现在只剩上线日期这一个点没定。我今晚把两个备选日期和各自的风险写成一页发到群里，大家提前看一下，会上直接定下来就行。你看可以吗？
note: 作为关键参会人，缩短比拒绝更好：点明只剩哪个问题，提前把材料给出去，最后请组织者确认。

situation: I'm in Singapore and our team lead Kate is in Chicago. She's put the weekly planning call at 8am Chicago every Tuesday, which is 9pm for me, and it's been two months. The US folks don't seem to notice.
reply: Hi Kate, could we look at the Tuesday planning slot? 8am Chicago is 9pm here in Singapore. Two options: I put my updates and blockers in the planning doc by my end of day Monday so they're there before the call, and I join live only when something needs me; or we alternate weeks, with every other call at 7pm Chicago, which is 8am Wednesday for me. Which works better for the team?
note: Time zones: name the cost once, without complaint, and give the organiser two workable alternatives rather than a bare no.

situation: A peer PM, Luis, keeps booking 'quick syncs' over my Tuesday and Thursday 9 to 12 focus blocks, even though they're on my calendar. He just put one in for this Thursday at 10. I'm a staff engineer and I don't want to be precious about it.
reply: Hi Luis, I'll skip Thursday at 10. If what you need is my go or no-go on the rollout flag, I'll post it in the channel by 5pm Wednesday. Tuesday and Thursday mornings are heads-down for me, so for anything live, 2 to 4 any afternoon works. Does that cover it?
note: Decline the slot, answer the likely question in writing, and name the window that does work, once, without a speech about focus time.

situation: I'm on annual leave Oct 12 to 16, booked since July. My manager Paul just sent an invite for a 'Q4 planning' session on Wednesday Oct 14. My part is the ops team's budget numbers, and my colleague Hana knows them well.
reply: Hi Paul, I'm on leave that week, 12 to 16 October, so I'll miss the planning session. My part is the ops budget, so I'll put the numbers and the three assumptions behind them in the planning doc by Friday 9 October, and Hana can take any questions on the day. Does that cover what you need?
note: Leave is a fact, not something to defend: decline the slot, send the substance early, and name who covers.

situation: I work part-time, Monday to Thursday, at a nonprofit. Our development director Helen keeps scheduling the grant planning meeting on Fridays at 10, and this week's invite is for Friday Oct 2. My part is the program outcomes section.
reply: Hi Helen, I don't work Fridays, so I'll miss Friday's planning meeting. My part is the program outcomes section: I'll have the draft and the three outcome figures you'll likely need in the grant folder by 4pm Thursday. For future sessions, Tuesday or Wednesday mornings work well if you'd like me there live. Does that cover what you need for Friday?
note: A part-time schedule is a fact, not a favour to ask: decline the slot, send the substance the day before, and name when you can join, once.

situation: Ich bin Einkäufer. Unser Verpackungslieferant will das Quartalsgespräch zu den Preisen für 2027 persönlich bei sich in Stuttgart machen, am Donnerstag, 15. Oktober. Das sind für mich zweieinhalb Stunden Fahrt pro Richtung für eine Stunde Gespräch.
reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, danke für die Einladung nach Stuttgart. Das Quartalsgespräch würde ich diesmal gern per Video führen, gleicher Tag, Donnerstag, 15. Oktober, um 10 Uhr. Wenn Sie mir Ihre Preisvorschläge für 2027 bis Dienstag, 13. Oktober schicken, komme ich mit konkreten Rückmeldungen statt nur mit Fragen. Für einen Besuch vor Ort nehme ich mir gern Zeit, wenn wir im Frühjahr die neue Linie abnehmen. Passt Ihnen das?
note: Das Format ablehnen, nicht die Beziehung: gleicher Termin per Video, Unterlagen vorab und ein echter Anlass für den nächsten Besuch.

situation: 前同事阿凯发微信想约我这周吃饭“聊聊”，我猜是想让我帮他内推我们公司的数据分析岗。我这周每天加班，也不想为这事专门吃顿饭。
reply: 阿凯，这周我天天加班，饭先不约了。如果是想了解我们公司的数据分析岗，你把简历发我，我对着岗位要求帮你看看，合不合适都跟你说实话，合适的话我帮你走内推。有具体问题也可以直接微信问，我晚上统一回你。你看这样行吗？
note: Name the likely need and meet it in writing; a guess phrased as 'if' lets him correct you without awkwardness.

situation: 我是孩子班上的家委会成员，负责运动会的物资采购。家委会的陈姐约了10月17日周六上午9点到11点在学校开会，那天我要陪我妈去医院复查。其实我那部分就是一张采购清单和预算。
reply: 陈姐好，17号周六上午的会我就不参加了，那天要陪家里老人去医院复查。我负责的物资采购清单和预算，16号周五晚上8点前发到群里，大家会前就能看完。会上有要改的地方直接在群里@我，我那天随时看手机回复。您看这样可以吗？
note: 志愿者之间也一样：拒绝的是开会这个形式，把自己负责的那部分提前交出来，再留一个找得到你的方式。

situation: 我是设计公司的项目经理，在给客户做官网改版。客户方的刘总希望从下周起每周一上午9点开一小时进度会，双方拉六个人。其实大部分进度一份周报就能说清，但我不想让他觉得我们在躲。
reply: 刘总好，每周同步进度我们完全赞成，想跟您商量一个更省大家时间的方式：每周五下午5点前，我把本周进度、下周计划和需要您拍板的事整理成一页周报发给您；周一的会改成隔周一次、30分钟，只讨论周报里需要决定的事。下周一10月5日上午9点照常开第一次会，把这个节奏一起定下来。您看这样可以吗？
note: 对客户不直接拒会：先认同他要的是掌握进度，用周报加更短更少的会替代，第一次会照开。

situation: I teach Year 10 English. A parent, Mr. Doyle, emailed asking to meet in person this week about why his daughter Freya got a B on her essay. My marking comments already flag the two things that kept it from an A, and parents' evening is on Thursday 15 October anyway.
reply: Dear Mr. Doyle, thank you for getting in touch. I think what you'd like is to understand what separated Freya's essay from an A. I'll email you a short note by Friday 2 October with the two things that made the difference and what she can focus on in her next essay. If you'd still like to talk it through after that, I'd be glad to at parents' evening on Thursday 15 October. Does that work for you?
note: With parents, answer the real question in writing first, so the scheduled evening is a genuine yes rather than a brush-off.

situation: Trabajo en una consultora en Valencia. Mi jefa de proyecto, Marta, me ha puesto en la reunión de seguimiento con el cliente del jueves 8 de octubre, de 10:00 a 11:30, pero a mí solo me toca contar el estado de las pruebas, unos diez minutos. El viernes tengo una entrega y necesito esa mañana para terminarla.
reply: Hola Marta, para la reunión del jueves lo que necesitas de mí es el estado de las pruebas. ¿Te parece si lo pongo como primer punto, lo cuento en diez minutos y me salgo a las 10:15? Así llego bien a la entrega del viernes. Te mando hoy un resumen de una página por si sale alguna pregunta cuando ya no esté. ¿Te encaja?
note: No rechaza la reunión, la acorta para sí: pide ir primero y deja por escrito lo que pueda surgir después.
